visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand with trimmed nails holds a blue-cased smartphone in front of a white desk surface scattered with charging cables and a black earbuds case. The phone screen displays a Google Maps UI overlaid on an Instagram story interface. The background is a brightly lit, cluttered office environment. (2) The scene cuts to a young woman sitting in a mesh office chair, turning her head to look directly at the camera with a wide-eyed, surprised expression. She has long, straight dark hair with pinkish-red highlights at the ends and wears a cream-colored oversized sweatshirt. Behind her, other office desks, computer monitors, and a patterned blanket on a chair are visible under even, white fluorescent lighting. (3) The woman continues talking, now smiling and gesturing with her right hand toward her ear while holding her phone in her left hand. Yellow variety-style subtitles appear at the bottom center of the frame. In the far background, a blurred figure of a coworker is briefly visible sitting at another desk. (4) A close-up shot of the phone screen shows a search for '電獺股份有限公司' on Google Maps, with a red pin dropped on a detailed street map of Taipei. The user's thumb interacts with the touchscreen to navigate the interface. (5) A screen recording sequence captures the woman's photo being selected in the Instagram app; she is wearing 8-bit style sunglasses in the photo. The Google Maps screenshot is then imported as an overlay, and the user demonstrates resizing and positioning it near the top of the frame. (6) The woman holds the phone back up toward the camera, showing the finished story post while winking and giving a thumbs-up gesture. The office setting remains consistent with bright, flat lighting. (7) A final close-up of the phone shows an animated version of the post where the map overlay bounces slightly. The video ends with the woman laughing and pointing playfully at the person behind the camera.
